installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Koaai installation script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# NOTE: only files under /mnt/server survive into the runtime container!
apt update
apt install -y ca-certificates curl xz-utils file

mkdir -p /mnt/server/bin
cd /tmp

## yt-dlp standalone linux build (nightly channel) -> lives in /mnt/server/bin
## so it persists into the runtime container. No system python/pip involved.
curl -sSL -o /mnt/server/bin/yt-dlp \
    "https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp-nightly-build/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp_linux"
chmod +x /mnt/server/bin/yt-dlp
/mnt/server/bin/yt-dlp --version

## Node.js runtime (passed to every yt-dlp call via --js-runtimes node)
NODE_VERSION=22.14.0
curl -sSL -o node.tar.xz "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-x64.tar.xz"
tar -xf node.tar.xz
cp "node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-x64/bin/node" /mnt/server/bin/node
/mnt/server/bin/node --version

## koaai binary - set KOAAI_DOWNLOAD_URL to fetch it, or leave empty and
## upload the binary yourself via SFTP / panel file manager (nothing compiles)
cd /mnt/server
if [ -n "$KOAAI_DOWNLOAD_URL" ]; then
    if [ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then
        curl -sSL -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}" -o koaai "${KOAAI_DOWNLOAD_URL}"
    else
        curl -sSL -o koaai "${KOAAI_DOWNLOAD_URL}"
    fi
else
    echo "KOAAI_DOWNLOAD_URL empty - using an already-uploaded binary"
fi
chmod +x koaai
file koaai

echo -e "install complete"
exit 0
